inputs.prompt: Original Soulmonsters hand-drawn 2D manga anime. Delicate fine gray ink, expressive oval eyes, simple nose and chin, slim youthful proportions, clean flat local colors, restrained cel shadows. No 3D, pixel art, poster painting, thick cartoon outlines, collage, titles, subtitles or logos. Maintain the identities, relative sizes and costume construction of the references. Motion must be actual character animation with changing joint poses and environmental movement, not a still-image zoom or slideshow. No spontaneous duplication or transformation. Tyler is the slim boy with black swept spiky hair, only three white outer side tufts (never an entirely white fringe), reddish eyes, ivory short-sleeved hooded jacket and burgundy lining/tails, black V-neck shirt/cropped trousers, fingerless gloves, small gold wheel pendant, burgundy sneakers. Saber is ONE white/pink living paper-kite feline: two attached upper saber fangs, four dark paws, red eyes, small gold collar bell, bamboo burgundy/ivory diamond sail on shoulders with a sakura emblem, one connected pink petal-ribbon tail. Her kite, tail, fangs and limbs stay attached. The girl Lia has warm brown skin, short dark curly bob, a single large yellow leaf-shaped hair clip, teal short poncho with cream collar, mustard shorts, brown ankle boots and a small coral crossbody satchel. She is a frightened young forest explorer, never a duplicate of Tyler. <Picture 1> is the START KEYFRAME and scene layout, not a sheet. <Picture 2> and <Picture 3> are character IDENTITY references only; never show sheets, text or white reference backgrounds in the film. Medium shot of Lia stepping from the right-side ferns onto the trail, Tyler and Saber visible at left listening. Seconds0-2 she takes two hurried steps and catches her breath. Seconds2-6 she points off-screen right toward the stream bridge, speaking frightened but clearly in Brazilian Portuguese: "Por favor, me ajudem! O Lacertubo não deixa ninguém passar pela ponte!" Seconds6-8 Tyler listens, Saber shifts protectively between them and the unseen threat. No running in place or teleporting. Audio Lia's one continuous line, breath, forest ambience.
